title: Independent words with a common glyph palette per line
method: Count lengths of lines and words and pooled EVA-basic glyphs in certain Currier B paragraph words on the ZL public practice training pages. Use the pinned control glyph inventory. Sort glyphs by decreasing pooled frequency and lexicographic tie-break and greedily allocate each to the currently lightest of four palettes, breaking load ties by index. For each line draw a palette uniformly and draw its length from the public line histogram. Draw word lengths independently from the public word histogram. At every glyph position flip a fair coin to draw with frequency weights from the line palette or from the pooled inventory. The same rule applies to every position, and no word sees any previous word or glyph. The matched control independently draws the palette per word and retains the same word and line lengths and marginal distribution for each word. The seed-260314 half-palette line sample is the sole submission. Further seeds and three-quarter-palette results are public practice diagnostics, with no sample selection.
